title.narrative: Japanese Social Development Fund (JSDF) Parallel to TF023779

description.narrative: "Fund amounts may be used to finance Project Grants and Capacity Building Grants for the following types of activities: (a) Project Grants may be used to finance activities directly providing relief measures, improvement of services and facilities for poorer population groups or reinforcing social safety nets and innovation and testing of new approaches, particularly in the social sectors, which could be replicated on a larger scale or included in operations financed by World Bank Group entities. (b) Capacity Building Grants may be used to finance the following types of activities: capacity building and improvement measures, such as bolstering local communities and non-government organizations (NGOs) to facilitate their involvement in operations financed by World Bank Group entities TO BENEFIT THE MOST FRAGILE AND VULNERABLE GROUPS IN ELIGIBLE COUNTRIES"
